chunks: And the secrets of the hearts exposed,

key_terms.الصُّدُورِ: hearts or chests (plural of صدر), referring to the inner recesses where thoughts and secrets reside

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the secrets of the hearts are exposed in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Qari'ah is often linked to the concept of 'Istidraj' or the gradual unveiling of the heart's secrets, emphasizing that divine knowledge penetrates the deepest layers of human intention. It serves as a powerful reminder for believers to purify their inner selves (Tazkiyah) so that their hidden thoughts align with their outward actions on the Day of Reckoning.
